decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the shop shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the moulding located above the fascia sign and the timber to be used elsewhere on the shop front have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
